output.interpretation: An authoritative vendor API notice states the field-dispatch v2 route endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01 and route pushes must now use v3; this is an operational/technical detail about how the push_route_update protected action is executed, not evidence about dispute volume, read-type mix, or any billing-calculation root cause already in evidence.

contradiction_assessment.rationale: push_route_update is listed in PD-1's intended_scope/protected_actions and authorized via DA-PUSH-ROUTE-UPDATE/K-DISPATCH; this notice means any future execution of that action against field-dispatch must target the v3 endpoint since v2 is retired, but it does not touch the root-cause (billing-import/dispute) premises of PD-1.

vob_proposals.unresolved_question: Has the field-dispatch tool integration been updated to call the v3 route-push endpoint (v2 retired 2026-10-01) before any push_route_update execution is attempted?
vob_proposals.validation_method: Check field-dispatch tool/API configuration confirms v3 endpoint usage before executing push_route_update.
required_evidence: field-dispatch tool configuration or vendor confirmation showing v3 endpoint is in use
vob_proposals.rationale: The vendor notice (fieldco-api-notice) shows the previously assumed v2 route endpoint is retired, so push_route_update, an authorized protected action under K-DISPATCH, could fail or misbehave if executed against the old endpoint.
